Dummy-vertex Hamiltonian-cycle reduction handles linear boundary. Certificate is exhaustive for all arcs of the finite 27/28-vertex graphs, not an unproved solver optimization. No claim about other alphabet sizes or lengths.

Chen–Kitaev–Sun 2020 full paper covers word deletions from all q-ary words and exact enumeration at q=2,n<=4, not minimum covering length for 27 ternary length-five palindromes. No equivalent target-set minima located in checked sources; historical specialized tables remain possible.

value.rationale: The 27-palindrome target language is canonical for the first ternary length-five case and not an arbitrary subset. Its exact cyclic/linear minima and their two-letter separation give reusable finite benchmarks for constrained superstrings, together with transparent independently checkable primal/dual optimum certificates.

limitations: Only alphabet size three and palindrome length five; no classification of other cases or all optimizers.
The finite lower bound rests on exact certificate arc checks plus the proved cover-to-tour reduction.
